id.description: The ROWID in voicemail.db, or <account folder>.<ROWID> for a per-account store.

date_utc.description: A UTC date and time, like 2024-07-05T16:10:00Z, or null when the backup has none.

phone_number.description: The caller's number, always, even when they're a saved contact.

contact_name.description: The caller's name in the address book, or null.

folder.description: The list the iPhone shows it in.

is_spam.description: Marked spam, whichever list it's in: a deleted spam voicemail is in deleted with is_spam true.

audio_path.description: A path inside the bundle folder, with / between folders, or null when the file isn't in the bundle.

audio_sha256.description: A SHA-256 hash in lower-case hex, or null.
